statement: Common DualSense report IMU carries three signed gyro and accel LE16 samples with calibration read from feature 0x05. Linux normalizes each axis via (raw - bias) * sensitivity numerator / denominator; gyro denominator comes from positive/negative gyro calibrations and the fixed gyro range, accel uses plus/minus ±g spans. VIIPER documents approximate raw scale 16.384 gyro counts/(deg/s), 8192 accel counts/g, but firmware/IMU revisions and orientation need physical verification.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: VIIPER const.go 94-115; Linux 1069-1142 and sensor report path; SDL 555-666. The counts in VIIPER are its synthesis, not globally established physical resolution.
